final_response.answer: For a CS major focused on cybersecurity, the key electives are CS 4264 (Principles of Computer Security), CS 4274 (Secure Computing Capstone), CS 5580 (Cryptographic Engineering), CS 5584 (Network Security), CS 5590 (System and Software Security) and CS 5594 (Blockchain Technologies). These courses appear in the Secure Computing major requirements and directly support cryptography and security skills. Additionally, BIT 4614 (Cybersecurity Management II) and BIT 4624 (Cybersecurity Analytics for Business) round out the cybersecurity elective set.
